row: Welcome to Arthur's Acres! Our mission is to rescue animals who have been abused, exploited or discarded, rehabilitate through patience, love, and respect, and to educate humans on cruelty-free life from daily choices. We also celebrate the individuality, personality and soul of each animal at our sanctuary. Meet some of our friends and follow their stories on our videos and lives!
